articles.title: Tink founders return with agentic compliance startup
articles.summary: Daniel Kjellén and Fredrik Hedberg, founders of the open banking platform Tink, which was acquired by Visa for $2.2B, have launched a new bootstrapped agentic compliance startup, Freda.

articles.title: Global banks take on agentic commerce scam and fraud concerns
articles.summary: A group of six global banks, including Bank of America and NatWest, has put together a set of principles designed to address concerns about scams, fraud and data privacy in agentic commerce.

articles.title: Agent workflow platform Promenaut goes live at HSBC
articles.summary: US-based agentic workforce platform Promenaut has gone into production at HSBC, delivering agent orchestration to specialised workflows within the bank’s operations.

articles.title: Rogers Bank completes agentic commerce transactions with Flybits and Mastercard
articles.summary: Mastercard, Flybits and Rogers Bank today announced Canada’s first successful deployment of a landmark agentic commerce transaction involving an AI-powered commerce platform, card issuer and payments network, demonstrating how AI-powered shopping experiences can prioritize consumer control, transparency and security.

articles.title: Smartstream embeds agentic AI into reconciliation tool
articles.summary: Smartstream, the trusted data solutions provider for leading global financial institutions and enterprises, today announces a new version of Smart Reconciliations Premium, introducing agentic AI that can investigate, progress and resolve reconciliation exceptions autonomously.

articles.title: Form3 launches AI agentic payments infrastructure
articles.summary: Form3, a leading global fintech offering account-to-account payments technology, today announced the launch of its new AI-enabled payments platform that will enable banks and fintechs to leverage AI agents within their payments operations.

articles.title: Misconception or Magic: What to Know About the Modern Wealth Management World
articles.summary: At the Communify Intelligence Experience, Rupert Baron, co-founder, TechnoWealth, returns to Finextra TV to unpack how the definition of wealth keeps moving and what that means for the industry. Baron argues the FCA's softening of the rules is nudging wealth management toward greater nuance rather than greater complexity, questions whether firms have truly embraced AI beyond the LLM, and reframes the great wealth transfer as a two-step process – first to the surviving spouse, statistically a woman, and only later to the next generation.
